Consolidated cash flow includes NCI economics. 31.779772m exchangeable Alclear units are excluded from diluted EPS as anti-dilutive; include relevant economic ownership only once.
2024 includes 175.548m release of valuation allowance through income tax and roughly 90.8m TRA establishment charge. NI and EPS are not clean operating growth comparators.
Company FCF deducts PPE purchases only. It is not unlevered FCF or cash attributable solely to class A, and excludes financing-classified TRA/NCI distributions and stock-withholding payments.
Not inferred by subtraction of year-to-date EPS or annual denominator. Use reported quarter EPS separately; no TTM EPS valuation supplied.

Basic economic denominator excludes RSU/PSU vesting scenarios. 4.213967m unvested RSUs require explicit treatment; 0.893234m performance-condition excluded shares are not established as incremental to this pool. Founder PSUs remaining were forfeited July 2, 2026.

No parent/Alclear entity split found in Q3 10-Q or FY25 10-K. Consolidated cash cannot automatically be allocated pro rata; TRA is a parent obligation and associated tax benefits must be matched without double counting.

Q2 2026 note6 gives 6M2025 software capitalization 6.244m but Q3 2026 note6 gives 9M2025 4.027m; no reconciliation found. FY25 and latest 9M disclosures used for TTM only, not a fabricated quarterly bridge.
Full payment/accrual/reclassification ledger is not disclosed. Do not equate change in total accrued liabilities with solely partnership cost.
